theorem.construction: For arbitrary simple G=(V,E), use F_G=AND_{xy in E}(x OR y OR s_xy) with fresh private s_xy. In the frozen moment relaxation each semantic product triple (x,y,p_xy) is FULL, so initial APAC leaves edge xy unresolved. The unresolved FULL-product graph induced on V equals G.
theorem.consequence: JANUS APAC hard cores have no universal fixed bound on raw product-graph treewidth or any proper hereditary graph-class restriction.

FOR EACH PRODUCT EDGE xy THE CHECK CIRCUIT CONTAINS A CONSTANT-SIZE AND GADGET JOINING x,y; CONTRACTING GADGETS RECOVERS ARBITRARY G AS A MINOR. THEREFORE NO FIXED UNIVERSAL CIRCUIT TREEWIDTH K.
